events.title: Family Movie Night
events.description: Make Mondays Family Night at La Bella Vista Club! Looking for an easy way to kick off the week? Bring the whole family to Family Movie Night every Monday at LBV! With every adult entrée purchase of $10 or more, receive one FREE kids’ meal! While you enjoy dinner, the kids can settle in for: A family-friendly movie Games Coloring pages An evening full of fun! It’s the perfect excuse to skip cooking, enjoy a delicious meal, and make some family memories together. La Bella Vista Club Every Monday 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM We can’t wait to see your family there!

events.title: Storytime
events.description: Storytime is back at the Library! Bring your little readers for a cozy morning filled with stories, imagination, and plenty of fun. It’s the perfect way to introduce young children to the magic of books while enjoying some quality time together. For ages 0–36 months Come snuggle up, turn the pages, and let the stories begin because it’s never too early to fall in love with reading!

events.title: Tapas & Trivia Tuesdays
events.description: TAPAS & TRIVIA TUESDAYS Think you know a little bit about everything? Time to prove it. Grab your smartest friends, come hungry, and make Tuesday night your trivia night at LBV! Enjoy tapas, put your random knowledge to good use, and see if your team has what it takes to come out on top. Every Tuesday 5–8 PM La Bella Vista Club Good food + good company + a little friendly competition = a much better Tuesday night.

events.title: Wing Wednesday
events.description: The best midweek tradition is back! It’s Wing Wednesday at La Bella Vista Club! Gather your friends, bring your appetite, and enjoy your favorite wings for just $1 each. Every Wednesday 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM Only $1 per wing (10-wing minimum, dine-in only) Choose from delicious flavors like: Buffalo Lemon Pepper Honey Chipotle Garlic Parmesan BBQ Cajun …and more! Pair them with your favorite dipping sauce and make your Wednesday plans easy. We’ll see you at LBV! See less

events.title: Tune Takeover
events.description: You pick it. We play it. Thursday nights just got even better at La Bella Vista Club! Join us for Tune Takeover, where you control the playlist. Whether you’re into country, rock, pop, hip-hop, throwbacks, or today’s hits, we’ll keep the music going with your requests all night long. Every Thursday 6:00 PM – Close Bring your friends, grab a drink, and enjoy a night filled with your favorite songs. Request it, sing along, and make Thursday night your own! What’s your first song request? Let us know in the comments!

events.title: Nerd Night & Pints
events.description: Nerd Nights & Pints Roll for a great night out! Looking for something different to do on Thursday nights? Grab your favorite board game, gather your friends, and head to La Bella Vista Club for an evening of games, laughs, and great drinks! Spend $10 or more and enjoy a FREE fountain drink, plus themed alcoholic and non-alcoholic drink specials. Light snacks are also available upon request. Every Thursday 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM Ages 16+ Whether you’re into strategy games, party games, or classic favorites, there’s always room at the table. See you Thursday!

events.description: Country Night – Facebook Caption Dust off your boots because Country Night is back at the La Bella Vista Club all August long! Every Friday beginning at 6 PM, enjoy your favorite country hits, great food, and a fun night out with friends. sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Use the official newcomers page for Aviano AB reporting instructions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival for on-base waitlists and off-base referrals. Temporary lodging is available through the base lodging office where offered.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival and assist with base orientation. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource, Military.com, and BaseDirectory for relocation support.
